implemented: Session owns distinct primary/secondary PostGraphSceneState and distinct Display states before ModelManager, MainView and adapter Project allocation.
Project.display aliases the session primary Display instead of making a separate lazy owner. Primary/secondary survive Project storage release and remain separate across sessions.

DisplayGeometryProfile explicitly distinguishes unresolved geometry from the historical OracleB camera adapter. No optional dimensions are present before a profile is applied; private zero storage is never presented as known native geometry.

The legacy projectDisplay helper retains prior camera output by applying OracleB3363x1709 adjusted for diagram height, now identified as historical. It never initializes secondary geometry by copying primary dimensions.
Existing model destruction tests continue to require the actual display owner to survive every Project-owned GuiModel destructor.
qualifications: This integrates recovered owner identities and lifetime, not all native QGraphicsScene/SfScene constructor effects, viewport attachment, fonts, text membership or signal callbacks.
Source-proven first/second scene allocations have intervening effects that are not simulated by C++ allocation timing. Full constructor failure/interruption equivalence remains pending.
Current scene item population remains unqualified; no empty-scene or completed text-construction inference is made.
Scene/Display diagnostic shared leases and original QObject/embedded-object teardown are not claimed identical. Normal native Close and final mainwindow destruction remain queued.
Historical geometry is not fresh original-session evidence and must not be used to silently authorize DOE snapshot geometry.
No public full-save guard or fresh-comparison acceptance gate is released.
